answer: Funding-graph clustering pays a farm once per funder. Each key registers the funder address of its first 10 POA, stored as a cipher tag, a salted hash that lets anyone match shared funders without revealing them. The jade, a public registry of tag-to-key edges, groups keys by tag. Each group earns one marble, a single reward share split among its members. A farm of 1,000 fakes on one funder earns 1 share, so it needs 1,000 separate funders at 10 POA each. Attacker pays 1,000 x 10 POA = 10,000 POA.
